//: Parallel to VoyageOS's eas.json, with two deliberate differences.
1. NO EXPO_PUBLIC_PURCHASE_HARNESS. That flag exists in VoyageOS because
VoyageOS sells something. Voyage Outdoor does not, so carrying the
variable across would be cargo — a flag nothing reads is a flag someone
later has to work out the meaning of.
2. EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL IS PINNED TO THE DEV PROFILES AND ABSENT FROM
production. This is the whole reason the file is worth reading.
EXPO_PUBLIC_ variables are inlined at BUILD time. app/src/config.ts
falls back from EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL to app.json's extra.apiUrl with no
warning, which is right for a release and a trap in development: a
build made in a shell that happened to have the variable set ships
pointing at a laptop, and looks completely normal until it is on
somebody else's phone. Until now the value was typed on the command
